name: Voidly Atlas MCP
description: Internet-censorship data for AI agents: country status, domain-blocking checks, citable incidents with evidence links to OONI, Censored Planet and IODA measurements, and Sentinel shutdown-risk forecasts. Also includes agent relay tools: relay writes are off until the owner enables them in the environment, and relay messages are relay-readable, not end-to-end encrypted.
author: Voidly

VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_HOME.description: Optional relay credential directory (default ~/.voidly/mcp-relay). Not needed for the censorship and forecast tools.

VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_DID.description: Optional relay identity (DID) the relay tools act as.

VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS.description: Optional comma-separated list of relay DIDs the agent may send to or create tasks for. Unset means relay sends are refused.

VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_ALLOW_OPEN_WRITES.description: Optional. Set to 1 to allow channel posts and profile changes on the relay. Unset means refused.

VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_ALLOW_STATE_CHANGES.description: Optional. Set to 1 to allow relay state changes other parties can see (joining channels, read marks, deletes). Unset means refused.

VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_ALLOW_MEMORY_WRITES.description: Optional. Set to 1 to allow relay-side memory writes (relay-readable). Unset means refused.
